description: Invite a staff member to join your DeskMonitor workspace by email. Use when the user asks to 'add an employee', 'invite a team member', 'send a team invite', 'onboard someone new', or 'invite [name] to my workspace'. The invite is sent by email — the recipient gets a link to set up their account and join the workspace. Only OwnerAdmin and Admin roles can invite staff. WARNING: This is a write tool — it sends a real email invitation and creates a workspace account invitation. Always confirm the email address AND full name with the user before calling this tool. Disabled in demo mode. Returns: { status, message, email, name }.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite. Must be a valid email. Required.

name.description: Full name of the person to invite (shown in the invitation email). Required.

position.description: Job title or role for the invitation display (e.g. Developer, Manager, Accountant). Optional — defaults to Employee.

name: invite_staff

email.description: Email address the invite was sent to

name.description: Name on the invitation, if provided

title: Invite Staff Member
